prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop website direction comp
Primary request: Create a 16:10 full-fidelity first viewport for the Portuguese technology studio Avancini OS in the approved “Atlas Vivo” visual world.
Scene/backdrop: warm mineral paper with subtle authentic paper grain, thin cobalt route lines and restrained editorial registration marks.
Subject: compact header with AVANCINI OS at left and ESTÚDIO, PROJETOS, SERVIÇOS, CONTATO, MENU. Monumental editorial headline “Tecnologia com direção para negócios em movimento.” A large cinematic project window takes roughly half the viewport and is labeled “PROJETO REAL — CLÍNICA SAN DIEGO”. Six route nodes appear as SITES, E-COMMERCE, IDENTIDADE, AUTOMAÇÃO, IA, SISTEMAS. Small CTA: “CONHECER PROJETOS”.
Style/medium: premium contemporary editorial atlas, Brazilian design studio quality, refined high-contrast serif paired with a precise grotesk.
Composition/framing: strongly asymmetric but clear; one dominant headline and one dominant project window; no card grid; no generic hero metric; enough of the next section visible to prove the system continues.
Color palette: paper #eeeae0, ink #151515, electric blue #3157ff, acid yellow #e8ff3d used once.
Text (verbatim): “AVANCINI OS”; “ESTÚDIO”; “PROJETOS”; “SERVIÇOS”; “CONTATO”; “MENU”; “Tecnologia com direção para negócios em movimento.”; “PROJETO REAL — CLÍNICA SAN DIEGO”; “SITES”; “E-COMMERCE”; “IDENTIDADE”; “AUTOMAÇÃO”; “IA”; “SISTEMAS”; “CONHECER PROJETOS”.
Constraints: exact legible Portuguese; no fake metrics, no testimonials, no green SaaS neon, no repeated rounded cards, no dashboard, no invented client logos.
